## Prerequisite: Whitney decomposition

Justification: needed for the Whitney family 𝒲 and (wh) in §4.4 (TeX l.1882); absent from Mathlib; a named textbook theorem (Stein, *Singular integrals*, VI.1.1–VI.1.2), formulated for nested partitions of a metric space by sets of diameter ≤ δ·2^{-k} so that it applies to the dyadic lattice 𝔔; file `LeanSparse/Auto/WhitneyDecomposition.lean`.
